description: This file defines a class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetDebugTemplate, which implements the method getDebugTemplate() for Smarty templates to retrieve the debugging template name.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetDebugTemplate
classes.description: A class that provides the getDebugTemplate() method to retrieve the debug template name from a Smarty template object.

methods.name: getDebugTemplate
methods.description: Returns the name of the debugging template associated with the Smarty template object.
